# America's ToothFairy

> A nonprofit organization dedicated to improving oral health access and education for underserved children across America.

America's ToothFairy, also known as the National Children's Oral Health Foundation, operates programs in multiple states including North Carolina, California, Ohio, and Missouri. Founded by Dr. Cherilyn Sheets, the organization has spent over 20 years providing dental education resources, hygiene supplies, and community outreach to low-income families and at-risk youth.

## Core Programs

- [Programs & Resources](https://www.americastoothfairy.org/programs): Overview of America's ToothFairy programs including Dental Resource, In the Gap, Special Kids, and Smile Drive.
- [Smile Guardian Program](https://www.americastoothfairy.org/programs/smile-guardian-program): Smile Guardian Program providing oral health education resource kits to at-risk communities.
- [Smile Drive](https://www.americastoothfairy.org/programs/smile-drive): Smile Drive Program distributing toothbrushes and dental hygiene supplies to low-income families.
